summary: Embedding signature inconsistency causes rerank reordering and intermittent latency spikes
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports intermittent rerank result reordering and spikes in end-to-end latency after their service experienced automatic fallback to an embedding variant. Impact: Search relevance for top-5 results is non-deterministically reordered and tail latency increases to 2-3x baseline, causing timeouts in downstream customer pipelines. Environment: prod/us-west, customer using enterprise dedicated capacity with model pinning to redwood-embed-v2. Observed around 2026-03-10 22:00 UTC onward.

Additional context: Customer's service calls our embeddings endpoint (model=redwood-embed-v2 or redwood-embed-v2-quant when available) and immediately POSTs returned vectors to /v1/rerank. They see intermittent 400/422 errors referencing "vector length mismatch" and occasional 504 gateway timeouts during rerank. Support observed that some embedding responses include an X-Embed-Signature header with value "v1" even when the request model parameter is v2, suggesting mixed rollout or fallback.

Requested action: Determine root cause (signature/version mismatch, fallback routing, or serialization bug), provide a remediation plan and immediate workaround for the customer.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) On prod/us-west, POST to /v1/embeddings with model=redwood-embed-v2 and example inputs (batch of 32 short queries).
2) Observe embedding response headers and vector length in payload; record X-Embed-Signature and embedding.length for each item.
3) Immediately submit embeddings array to /v1/rerank with model=redwood-rerank-v1 and measure latency and ordering of top-k results.
4) Repeat for several minutes at 5-10 qps to exercise routing and potential fallback behavior.
logs: 2026-03-10T22:04:12Z ERROR api-gateway request_id=abc123 status=504 upstream=rerank timeout=30s route=/v1/rerank
2026-03-10T22:04:08Z INFO embeddings request_id=abc122 model=redwood-embed-v2 X-Embed-Signature=v1 vector_len=768
2026-03-10T22:04:08Z INFO embeddings request_id=abc123 model=redwood-embed-v2 X-Embed-Signature=v2 vector_len=1024
2026-03-10T22:05:01Z WARN reranker request_id=def456 input_vector_len=768 expected_len=1024 error=shape_mismatch
observed_behavior: Intermittent mixing of embedding signatures (v1/v2) for requests specifying model=redwood-embed-v2. When a v1-length vector lands at rerank that expects v2 vectors, reranker returns shape_mismatch and downstream retries increase latency. When fallback occurs en masse, tail latency spikes and some requests timeout (504). Rerank top-k ordering shifts when embeddings are recomputed client-side as a workaround, indicating cross-model embedding incompatibility drove quality changes.
expected_behavior: Embedding responses for a given model parameter should consistently return vectors of the documented length and include a matching X-Embed-Signature header. Reranker should reject mismatched inputs gracefully with a clear error and our routing should not silently fallback to older signature variants for pinned models.
investigation_notes: Engineers reproduced shape_mismatch locally by forcing mixed rollback: quantized pool returns v1-shaped vectors while control path returns v2-shaped vectors.

Routing logs show intermittent fallback to 'compat' pool when a GPU node reported OOM for quantized kernel; autoscaler brought up compat instances but did not honor model signature header consistency.
We observed that X-Embed-Signature is present but not validated by the API gateway, allowing a vector of different dimension to be forwarded to reranker without early rejection.
Related PR flagged: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3456 modifies embedding pool selection — intersects with fallback window.
Customer traces show that enabling client-side validation removed 422/shape_mismatch but increased client CPU and latency; this is not acceptable long term.
comments: Support (Aisha Kumar) 2026-03-11: Customer reported surge in rerank failures and provided initial logs — opening ticket and escalating to SRE.
SRE (Daniel Park) 2026-03-12: Noted autoscaler events around 2026-03-10 22:00 UTC and a spike in 'compat' pool allocations. Assigning to runtime team to verify pool signature guarantees.
Runtime (Morgan Lee) 2026-03-13: Reproduced locally by simulating quantized kernel OOMs; adding hypothesis that pool selection doesn't enforce vector schema compatibility for pinned models.

Customer (NimbleSearch SE) 2026-03-13: Confirmed enabling explicit model-version header mitigated errors temporarily; requests continued but with higher tail latency. Asking for permanent fix timeline.
resolution_notes: Temporary workaround provided to customer: 1) set explicit header X-Requested-Embed-Version: v2 and 2) enable client-side vector length validation before calling rerank. Longer-term fix: runtime team to enforce pool selection that guarantees embedding schema compatibility for pinned model versions and add pre-rerank header validation in API gateway. Target patch PR opened and linked; ETA for hotfix rollout: 2026-03-18. Follow-up: add automated test in CI to assert embedding signature/length invariants across all routing paths.
